skills.name: Dappier
skills.description: Use when building AI agents, LLM applications, or integrations that need real-time data access. Reach for Dappier when you need to fetch live web search results, financial data, news, weather, sports updates, or AI-powered content recommendations from verified sources. Use it to power chatbots, function-calling workflows, MCP servers, or RAG systems with current, rights-cleared data.
